description: Fires when the agent is about to end its turn. Injects the completion self-check prompt — (1) is everything from the request done, anything missed? (2) any concrete follow-ups to fix/improve/remove? — turning the textual ritual into an enforced reminder. Blocks the stop ONCE (exit 10 with the prompt) so the agent runs the check; a marker prevents an infinite loop. on_error=open.
